rules.name: asks the app to toggle when the dock toggle is clicked
rules.note: The dock does not change its own placement: the app passes the next placement (side and rail on a wide screen, sheet and peek on a narrow one), whose markup the fixtures show. The same holds for the expand and collapse button of the sheet and the peek.

rules.name: grows the sheet to its tall height on ArrowUp on the handle
rules.note: ArrowDown goes back to var(--layout-sheet-height). Both keys are always prevented on the handle, even when the height is already at that end.

rules.name: switches between the two heights on a keyboard click of the handle
rules.note: A pointer click switches too, unless it ends a drag that moved 12px or more.

rules.name: follows a drag of the handle and settles at the nearest height or closes
rules.source: Dock.svelte and dock-sheet.svelte.ts (DockSheet), dock.ts (press, follow, release, dockSheetSettle)
rules.note: While dragging, the height is written in px, clamped between 0 and the tall height. On release after moving at least 12px it settles at the nearest of closed, standard and tall, or, after a flick, at the next one in the flick direction; settling at closed calls ontoggle. The two .dock-probe elements measure the token heights.
